title: Comments explain why, not what the code does
context: Code that restates what is obvious from reading it wastes space. The codebase is dense and intentional.
decision: Every module opens with a doc comment explaining what the module is for and what seam it sits on, not restating its name. Beyond that, record the alternative rejected and why (highest-value comment), document what is deliberately absent, and note when something is safe to call twice, capped, or lossy.
consequences: Modules require thoughtful documentation explaining rationale. Comment concentration is capped: no file more than 50% comment lines, no unbroken run over 20 lines. Oversized headers get distributed onto specific items, tightened, then moved to `docs/design-notes/` with the source pointing at the page.
